title: Rollo has a job for you

nodes.speaker: Rollo
nodes.text: Hey boss. You looking for... something extra?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey boss. You looking for... something extra?

nodes.speaker: Rollo
nodes.text: You.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You.

nodes.speaker: Rollo
nodes.text: I've heard about you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've heard about you.

nodes.speaker: Rollo
nodes.text: I knew it. You got that look. Like a hungry badger.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I knew it. You got that look. Like a hungry badger.

nodes.speaker: Rollo
nodes.text: Scratch. Loot. Dough. Jimmy Slims.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Scratch. Loot. Dough. Jimmy Slims.

nodes.speaker: Rollo
nodes.text: Keep your voice down. You want that ferret Teleshko to hear?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Keep your voice down. You want that ferret Teleshko to hear?

nodes.speaker: Rollo
nodes.text: Extra-legal. Easy money though, for the right pair of hands...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Extra-legal. Easy money though, for the right pair of hands...

nodes.speaker: Rollo
nodes.text: My old boss needs someone to fix a place up pronto. Make it look normal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My old boss needs someone to fix a place up pronto. Make it look normal.

nodes.speaker: Rollo
nodes.text: Yeah, you know. A totally "normal" apartment. Definitely not the kind of place to run an extended narcotics operation from.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, you know. A totally "normal" apartment. Definitely not the kind of place to run an extended narcotics operation from.

nodes.speaker: Rollo
nodes.text: Nah. These investigations never find anything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nah. These investigations never find anything.

nodes.speaker: Rollo
nodes.text: That snitchy little shit surveillance drone knows my face.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That snitchy little shit surveillance drone knows my face.

nodes.speaker: Rollo
nodes.text: Yeah. Quickly. Without being seen by security.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. Quickly. Without being seen by security.

nodes.speaker: Rollo
nodes.text: Boss'll make it worth your while, "boss."

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Boss'll make it worth your while, "boss."

nodes.speaker: Rollo
nodes.text: Yeah, well, thanks for wasting my time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, well, thanks for wasting my time.

nodes.speaker: Rollo
nodes.text: Who said anything about a crime scene? It's "redecorating". Quickly. Without being seen by security.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who said anything about a crime scene? It's "redecorating". Quickly. Without being seen by security.

nodes.speaker: Rollo
nodes.text: Heard on the wire you're good with... furniture.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Heard on the wire you're good with... furniture.

nodes.speaker: Rollo
nodes.text: Yeah. "Decorating". I know someone that needs that doing... Quietly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. "Decorating". I know someone that needs that doing... Quietly.

nodes.speaker: Rollo
nodes.text: Angry cow-dog.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Angry cow-dog.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: "Me."

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "Me."

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Meaning?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Meaning?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Always.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Always.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you want?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not surprised. I'm kind of a big deal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not surprised. I'm kind of a big deal.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Not surprised. I'm kind of a big deal.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Not surprised. I'm kind of a big deal.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's a badger?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's a badger?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you mean money?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you mean money?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds a bit illegal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds a bit illegal.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Count me out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Count me out.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm listening.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm listening.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: "Normal"?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "Normal"?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Your old boss... sounds like they're in trouble.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your old boss... sounds like they're in trouble.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Your old boss... sounds like they're in trouble.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Your old boss... sounds like they're in trouble.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So I just need to... re-decorate an apartment?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So I just need to... re-decorate an apartment?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So I just need to... re-decorate an apartment?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So I just need to... re-decorate an apartment?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why don't you do it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why don't you do it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And you'll pay me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you'll pay me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No thanks. I've got bigger fish to fry.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No thanks. I've got bigger fish to fry.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No thanks. I've got bigger fish to fry.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No thanks. I've got bigger fish to fry.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Consider it done.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Consider it done.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I've had enough of cleaning up crime scenes to be honest.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've had enough of cleaning up crime scenes to be honest.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I've had enough of cleaning up crime scenes to be honest.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I've had enough of cleaning up crime scenes to be honest.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You mean decorating?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You mean decorating?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right. So what do you want?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right. So what do you want?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Right. So what do you want?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Right. So what do you want?
